Pal Condensation Guide

Condensation makes a Pal permanently stronger by sacrificing copies of the same species at the Pal Essence Condenser. Boosts stats, partner skill level and work suitability.

On this page
  • How it works
  • Levels & costs
  • Tips

How it works

Use the Pal Essence Condenser (crafted at the Ancient Technology tree) and sacrifice Pals of the same species as your target Pal. Each condensation level raises the Pal's stats and partner skill level, and adds work suitability bonuses. A Pal can reach condensation level 5 (5 stars).

Levels, costs & bonuses

LevelSacrificesPartner skillStat bonusWork suitability
1 N/A 1 N/A N/A
2 4 2 5% +1 to its best suitability
3 8 3 10% +1 to its 2nd-best suitability
4 12 4 15% +1 to its 3rd-best suitability
5 24 5 20% +1 to every suitability

Tips

  • Only sacrifice same-species Pals — a Lamball can't condense a Chikipi.
  • Condensing a maxed Pal is the strongest single upgrade in the game for your main team.
  • Prioritize condensing your mounts and combat Pals first — the stat boost is massive.
  • Condensation bonuses also boost partner skill effects, including mount speed.
  • Keep low-level duplicates from breeding runs — they're perfect sacrifice material.
Related: breed extras to sacrifice with the Breeding Calculator, and see which Pals are worth maxing on the Best Pals for Combat list.
